item.title: Gacha Go! Article
item.description:
Ananta demo impressions from Gamescom 2026 point to an open-world RPG that is fast, playful and deliberately chaotic. Media attending the event sampled different slices of Naked Rain and NetEase’s free-to-play game, from a story mission and parkour to a vehicle chase and open exploration.
The previews do not amount to a verdict on the full game, but they give a clearer picture of how Ananta’s urban open world feels in motion ahead of its January 15, 2027 global release.
Famitsu played both a story section and an exploration segment. The story demo followed Eiryu through a straightforward stealth sequence before opening into fast parkour across the city. Enemy footsteps and sudden set pieces added tension, while forgiving retries kept the mission moving.
The outlet found traversal immediately responsive and noted that the otherwise serious story made room for comic moments. Its exploration session moved away from central Nova City to the more rural Chongxiao area, where activities included ring toss, target shooting and tea roasting.
IGN’s hands-on highlighted the scale of Ananta’s ideas: exaggerated action, several playable characters and a wide range of activities packed into a short session. That variety made the demo exciting, but it also left the preview feeling pulled in several directions during approximately 45 minutes of play.
The takeaway was less that any one element failed and more that Ananta still has to prove its many systems can form a coherent whole.
JPGAMES played two demos. The first was a linear chase starring the wolf-hybrid agent Lykaia , combining shooting, driving and an outnumbered fight. Motorcycles, cars and enemies were thrown through the scene with the kind of cartoon exaggeration already familiar from Ananta’s trailers.
The second demo offered free exploration. Movement included a web-swinging-style traversal ability, while environmental interactions ranged from improvised combat tools to a small tea-leaf washing activity. The contrast between high-speed action and mundane city diversions appears central to the game’s identity.
Across the previews, three consistent points emerge: movement feels responsive , the world supports a broad range of activities, and the presentation is comfortable switching between serious missions and absurd spectacle.
The main unanswered question is cohesion. Short event demos can showcase variety, but they cannot show how progression, character switching and the free-to-play structure will work across dozens of hours. Those systems will matter more than the number of activities available at launch.
For now, the press demos support a measured conclusion: Ananta has a distinct personality and plenty of mechanical ambition, but its full-game structure remains the part to watch.

item.title: Gacha Go! Article
item.description:
Zenless Zone Zero 3.2 , “Their Secret Histories,” launches on September 9, 2026 . The update introduces the new Armorer specialty, adds S-Rank agents Claret and Roxy across two banner phases, and gives players access to free Angels of Delusion outfits through version events.
HoYoverse confirmed the date and full update lineup in its official Version 3.2 announcement . The patch will release simultaneously on PS5 and PS5 Pro, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Cloud Gaming, Xbox PC, Windows PC, Steam, iOS and Android.
Zenless Zone Zero 3.2 goes live on September 9 . HoYoverse has not yet published the maintenance timetable or the final download size, so players should wait for the in-game maintenance notice before planning around server downtime.
The platform list includes every current global version of the game:
Players preparing for the new banners can use our Zenless Zone Zero Pity Calculator to estimate pulls and Polychrome costs before Claret and Roxy arrive.
Claret is an S-Rank Electric agent and the first member of the new Armorer specialty. She is the Administrative Director of Flint Workshop and the head of the Flint family, with a kit that turns defensive investment into offensive damage.
Armorer agents are built around the balance between attack and defense. The specialty adds two mechanics to Zenless Zone Zero: Maim and multi-CRIT .
Claret builds Gash on enemies through her attacks. Once the effect is fully stacked, certain skills trigger Maim for extra damage and grant a Laceration damage boost. Her abilities use DEF as their base damage multiplier, making DEF part of her direct damage calculation rather than a purely defensive stat.
Her multi-CRIT mechanic activates when CRIT Rate exceeds 100%. The excess rate can produce additional critical hits calculated through Laceration damage, while part of her starting CRIT DMG is converted into CRIT Rate. HoYoverse therefore points to DEF, CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG as the three central build stats for Claret.
Armorer agents can also trigger Counter Assists against certain enemy control skills, contesting the attack and pushing the target back. Claret and her signature W-Engine will headline the first half of Version 3.2.
Roxy , Flint Workshop’s chief smith, is an S-Rank Wind Stun agent. Her core mechanic creates Eyes of the Storm through a held EX Special Attack, leaving tornadoes on the battlefield that she can gather and detonate.
Combining those storm effects produces a larger tornado, while her Ultimate generates several tornadoes for a wide frontal strike. Roxy and her exclusive W-Engine will arrive in the second half of the update.
The rerun schedule is split in the same order:
HoYoverse has not announced the exact phase-change date. The in-game Signal Search schedule will provide the final start and end times for each banner.
Zenless Zone Zero 3.2 begins a two-patch outfit campaign for the Angels of Delusion . By completing related events during Versions 3.2 and 3.3, players can collect faction-series outfits without buying them from the store.
The 14-day “Surprise Screening Plan” check-in lets players select one Angels of Delusion outfit after completing its required visits. The “Clink, Clank, Pinball Knight!” event offers another outfit through the Angels Support Operation page once its Challenge Mode is cleared.
Version logins will also award a total of 10 Encrypted Master Tapes and 10 Boopons . These are separate from the event outfits and give players ten limited-banner pulls plus ten Bangboo searches over the patch.
Check our Zenless Zone Zero codes page for currently active livestream and promotional codes before the update launches.
“Their Secret Histories” sends the Proxies to Vyrium , a special zone within the Shrouded Reef, as they continue treating the mutated power inside their body. The investigation reveals that TOPS has already infiltrated Roscaelifer.
At the same time, a shipment of Porcelloy disappears from a transfer station. Claret and Roxy investigate the missing cargo and draw the Proxies into a case connected to a covert research facility and Helios Academy .
Lindverne Sunbringer, Administrative Director of the Airspace Patrol Department, asks Claret to investigate Porcelloy leads in the remnants of Girtablullu. HoYoverse is framing the chapter around old classmates, a reunion after years apart and secrets Sunbringer has kept hidden.
Beyond the pinball event, Zenless Zone Zero 3.2 adds the virtual pet event “Diary of an Orbie Parent,” the Booastrum detective event “Chronicles of the Hobbling Crow,” and the HIA combat event “Shadow Chase Showdown.” Rewards include Polychromes, Tuning Calibrators and other upgrade materials.
Enigma of the Labyrinth: Operation Bagel receives a standard seasonal update. It adds new Z-Rank valuables, character Gear, advanced challenges, refreshed server rankings and seasonal missions. Claret and Roxy also join the mode with new Tactical Prisms, Armorer Gear and exclusive Hollow Zero equipment.
A new Break-Even Beacon can send a Bangboo away with part of the collected supplies before extraction. Those items still count even if the run fails, reducing the risk attached to a bad evacuation. HoYoverse says a larger themed season with new maps, systems and high-difficulty challenges is still in development.
The Beginner Guide expands to include Jane, Hugo and Soldier 0 – Anby . Players who did not claim their Version 3.1 self-select Agent can choose one after the 3.2 update, then select the matching exclusive W-Engine after completing the Phase 2 missions.
Koleda receives an enhancement, and Perfect Assist signals become more consistent: golden flashes will trigger Defensive Assist, while red flashes will trigger Evasive Assist. The VR Training Room also gains an Armorer-specific training stage.
For the broader roster picture before the new specialty arrives, see our Zenless Zone Zero tier list and the main Zenless Zone Zero hub .

item.description:
BLEACH Mirrors High pre-registration has opened on Google Play , giving Android players the first live storefront for Bandai Namco’s new mobile RPG. The publisher continues to target a 2026 release , although it has not announced an exact launch date.
The official Google Play page went live under Bandai Namco Entertainment and was updated on August 26. The game’s official website lists both iOS and Android, but an App Store pre-order is not available through the global site at the time of publication.
Mirrors High is not presented as a retelling of Ichigo Kurosaki’s original journey. Bandai Namco describes it as a new story that begins after BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War , with familiar Soul Reapers appearing alongside an original cast.
Those new characters were designed by series creator Tite Kubo . Ichigo, Rukia and other returning characters will use their original Japanese voice actors, while players take a more personal role through an avatar of their own.
The premise centers on the Soul Society and a new threat emerging after the war. Bandai Namco has not yet published a complete chapter outline or confirmed which returning characters will be playable at launch.
The Google Play description outlines a three-character squad system . Players combine attack cards during battle, then build toward larger Soul Drive attacks rather than controlling a single fighter for every encounter.
Bandai Namco also confirms avatar appearance options and Zanpakuto customization . The store copy links those systems to the player’s progression through the new story, suggesting that the custom Soul Reaper is more than a menu profile.
The game is free to download and includes in-app purchases, including random items. The publisher has not revealed banner rates, pity rules, launch characters or pre-registration reward milestones, so none of those systems can be confirmed from the current store page.
Android users can register directly through Google Play and receive the normal store notification when the game becomes available. The page does not display a release date or installation size.
For iPhone and iPad, Bandai Namco still names iOS as a supported platform on the official site. However, there is currently no global App Store link alongside the Android button. Players should therefore treat Google Play as the only confirmed live pre-registration storefront for now.
The original teaser used a summer 2026 window, while the latest coverage and store rollout continue to place the game in 2026. Bandai Namco has not narrowed that to a specific day, and Google Play does not provide a public date.
We are keeping BLEACH Mirrors High in the undated 2026 section of the Gacha Release Calendar . That entry will move as soon as Bandai Namco publishes a launch notice rather than a storefront estimate.
Mirrors High arrives after a mixed period for licensed mobile games. It is a separate project from KLab’s BLEACH: Brave Souls and the now-closed BLEACH Soul Puzzle , with Bandai Namco handling the new game’s publication.
Our Bandai Namco company page tracks the publisher’s active and closed gacha titles. The regional and global status of older BLEACH games is also recorded separately in our service tracker.

item.title: Gacha Go! Article
item.description:
Silver Palace pre-registration is now available through the App Store, Google Play, PlayStation Store and Epic Games Store . The new storefront rollout confirms the global version for iOS, Android, PS5 and Windows PC, but Elementa still has not announced a release date.
This is an expansion of the campaign rather than the first day of global pre-registration. Elementa opened registration through the official Silver Palace website in May 2025 ; the August 28 announcement adds platform-specific store pages where players can reserve or follow the game.
The buttons are not identical across stores. Apple and Google offer mobile pre-registration, while Sony and Epic currently use their normal wishlist systems for games marked as coming soon. The official website remains a separate registration route.
The PlayStation Store page identifies Silver Palace as a PS5 game and lists PS5 Pro enhancements, DualSense vibration and Game Help support. It also states that online play is required and that optional in-game purchases are included.
On PC, the Epic Games Store page lists Windows support and marks the game as coming soon. Steam and Xbox versions have not been announced, so the new campaign should not be read as confirmation for either platform.
Apple currently displays January 31, 2027 as an expected release date. That date comes from the App Store listing, not from an Elementa announcement, and the other official storefronts continue to show no date.
App Store pre-order pages require developers to provide an expected date and can be changed before release. For that reason, Gacha Go! is keeping Silver Palace listed as TBA in the Gacha Release Calendar until Elementa confirms a launch date directly.
Silver Palace is a free-to-play open-world action adventure RPG set in Silvernia, an industrialized city shaped by the discovery of Silverium. Players take the role of a returning detective, investigate crimes and conspiracies, and switch between party members during real-time combat.
The Google Play listing also discloses in-app purchases that include random items. The Epic page lists English, Japanese, Korean and Chinese voice options, while the PlayStation listing describes the title as a single-player online experience.
Elementa has not attached milestone rewards to this storefront announcement. It has also not confirmed cross-save, simultaneous launch timing for every platform or an exact global release window. Those details remain open despite the broader Silver Palace pre-registration rollout.
The game has moved through multiple test periods since its 2025 reveal, including the recent Dichotomy beta on PC. The storefront rollout follows its gamescom 2026 appearance, where Elementa showed a new trailer and publicly named PlayStation alongside PC and mobile.
For a longer look at the game itself, our Silver Palace release-date and beta overview tracks the confirmed platforms and testing history. Our Dichotomy beta report covers the build players tested before the store pages went live.

The Ayakashi: Romance Reborn end-of-service date for the Japanese mobile app is 14:00 JST on November 27, 2026 . Voltage announced the closure on August 27, ending a run that began in Japan on October 30, 2018.
The official Japanese notice applies to Ayakashi Koi Meguri , the original Japanese live-service app. Voltage says it reached the decision after concluding that it could no longer provide a service that would satisfy players.
Most in-app item sales ended immediately when the announcement was published. One small Diamond pack remains available for a limited period before sales close completely.
The remaining month of Diamond sales does not change the closure date. Players will lose access to the Japanese live service once the servers go offline in November.
Players with unused paid Diamonds will be able to request a refund under Japan’s Payment Services Act. Voltage will publish the application method after service ends, so affected players should keep the app installed and retain any account information that may be needed to identify their balance.
The refund applies only to the unused paid-Diamond balance. Voltage states that other items are not eligible, regardless of whether they were obtained for free or purchased as part of a package.
The closure announcement names the Japanese app and does not announce the end of every version carrying the Ayakashi: Romance Reborn name. Voltage’s English-language mobile site had not posted a matching end-of-service notice at the time of publication.
That distinction matters because the localized English and Thai mobile edition launched separately in June 2019. Until Voltage publishes an equivalent notice for that version, the confirmed shutdown should be treated as Japan-only .
The Nintendo Switch release is also a separate, standalone product. It packages the Dawn and Twilight chapters for offline single-system play and is not identified in the mobile service notice.
Ayakashi Koi Meguri debuted in Japan on October 30, 2018. The card-based otome RPG follows an onmyoji heroine and a cast of ayakashi during Japan’s Meiji era, combining story chapters, character routes and limited live-service events.
By the shutdown date, the Japanese app will have operated for just over eight years. The Ayakashi: Romance Reborn end of service is now recorded in the Gacha End of Service Tracker , where regional servers are recorded separately when only one edition is affected.

item.title: Gacha Go! Article
item.description:
Nodusfall is the game HoYoverse had not told anyone about. It premiered during gamescom Opening Night Live, and by the time the broadcast moved on, its official website was already live with pre-registration open.
You play a Weaver . In the studio’s own words, the game drops you into “a world where divine authority has crumbled, and order has collapsed”, where you forge bonds with companions, stand together against earth-shattering foes, seize whatever divinity remains and try to put the world back in order.
The site frames it around four ideas: facing mighty foes, breaking a deadlock by fighting alongside allies, taking divine power from enemies to unlock Divine Skills of your own, and switching roles and loadouts freely to claim better relics from bigger fights. In short, a co-op action RPG — a shape HoYoverse has not published before.
The game has no release date and no announced platforms . HoYoverse has not described its monetisation either, so whether it follows the gacha model of the rest of the catalogue is, for now, an open question. The site is running pre-registration and nothing else.
The name is worth getting right while it is still new: the official site writes it as Nodusfall , one word.

item.title: Gacha Go! Article
item.description:
Petit Planet has a launch window. HoYoverse’s cozy galactic life sim arrives in Winter 2026 , confirmed in the description of the gamescom special video the game published on its own channel: “Petit Planet launches in Winter 2026. See you where the stars bloom.”
It is worth being precise about what was given here, because a Petit Planet release date in the strict sense still does not exist. Winter 2026 is a season, and the announcement does not narrow it to a month. What it does settle is the year, which had been open since the game was unveiled.
Pre-registration is open , linked from the same video. If you are here looking for a Petit Planet release date to put in a calendar, the honest answer is that HoYoverse has given a season and not a day.
Petit Planet is making its international exhibition debut at gamescom, in Hall 6 , under the theme “Connect the Vibe” , with a hands-on PC demo running from August 26 to 30 . Players step in as a Planet Tender: farming, building, exploring the Starsea and spending time with the Neighbors who live on it.
It shares the show with Honkai: Nexus Anima , the other HoYoverse title making its gamescom debut, both of them in dedicated zones alongside Genshin Impact, Honkai: Star Rail and Zenless Zone Zero.

item.title: Gacha Go! Article
item.description:
Ananta finally has a day on the calendar. NetEase’s urban open world RPG launches globally on January 15, 2027 , a date the team confirmed with a dedicated trailer during gamescom Opening Night Live and now carries in the title of its official website .
The announcement did two things at once. It closed the question that had followed the game since it stopped being Project Mugen , and it opened pre-registration , which the official site now runs with a live counter of sign-ups. There is no staggered regional rollout in the announcement: the date given is a global one.
The site is also further along than a placeholder: it already carries sections for Characters , Locations and Milestones , which is not what a studio puts up eighteen months out.
Ananta is built by Naked Rain and described by its own site as an urban open world RPG where you play as a variety of characters across a city of business districts, hidden alleyways, quiet tea towns and busy old streets, assembling a team as you meet its cast.
That is the pitch the game has been making since its first showings, and it is the reason it kept turning up on most-wanted lists without a date attached. Now it has one, and it lands in the middle of January, which puts it at the head of the 2027 calendar rather than buried in the December rush.
The wait has been long enough to be worth measuring: we covered the game when it was still called Project Mugen, again when its offline technical tests ran in China, and again days ago when it returned to gamescom with new gameplay footage. The Ananta release date is the piece that was missing from all three.

item.title: Gacha Go! Article
item.description:
Ten agents, one at a time, in a random order. You place each one from 1 to 10 and the place you use is gone.
All 57 agents are in the pool. Hit start and the first one walks in. If nothing loads here, your browser is blocking scripts.
Ten agents, ten places. They arrive one at a time, in a random order, and you decide where each one goes on a list from 1 to 10. Once a place is taken it stays taken, and you cannot see who is coming.
Everyone in the game can show up: all 57 agents. Every run draws a different ten from that pool, so no two rankings are the same and a run takes about two minutes.
Keyboard works too: press 1 to 9 for those places and 0 for tenth.
Our Zenless Zone Zero tier list , codes, release calendar, guides and everything else we have on the game live in the Zenless Zone Zero hub .
